jurisdiction_name: WEST JEFFERSON WARD1 (WEST JEFFERSON VILLAGE Village)
narrative: West Jefferson Ward1 (Village of West Jefferson Village) has 784 registered voters, with 60.8% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 21.7% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 17.5%, a modest Republican lean of 4.2 percentage points.
